title: Wars Of Westeros
description: Game Of Thrones Modpack used for our own Nations RP Server
body:
Wars of Westeros is a realistic medieval roleplay modpack built for players who want political conflict, kingdom management, and large-scale warfare without magic or fantasy elements.
This pack focuses on grounded gameplay inspired by feudal societies: ruling houses, armies, recruitment, diplomacy, economy, and immersive worldbuilding.

Main Features
⚔️ Warfare & Realistic Combat
Enhanced melee mechanics, grounded weapon variety, and armor systems that support duels, skirmishes, and full-scale battles.

🏰 Kingdom & Settlement Management
Build, expand, and govern settlements with NPC workers, guards, and systems that allow players to manage towns like lords or regional rulers.

🛡 Recruitable Units & Army Control
Command soldiers, form squads, and deploy units—allowing players to lead troops similar to a medieval strategy system.

🌍 Hand-crafted Medieval World Generation
A fully overhauled terrain experience with realistic mountains, valleys, forests, and regions suitable for building castles, towns, and entire kingdoms.

💱 Economy & Politics
Trade, taxation tools, currency systems, and RP-friendly mechanics that support diplomacy, alliances, and rivalries between player-led houses.

🎭 Immersive Roleplay Tools
Voice chat, cosmetic options, and RP-oriented systems to support events, character identity, and story-driven gameplay.

📈 Optimized for Servers
Includes performance and stability mods to ensure smooth gameplay for large player communities and faction-based servers.
